source.license: Not specified by original source; selected factual ranges only are reproduced here, not chord files or audio.
source.annotator: Isophonics curators; secondary musical analysis by Alan W. Pollack

songs.selection_rationale: Clear C/A/C bridge confirmed by independent musicological analysis; main-key borrowed/secondary chords remain within C. Held out from prior development corpus.
limitations: Pollack corroborates the main C/A/C scheme but also describes a brief A shift in the outro. Therefore reference after 160 s is deliberately unscored.
Isophonics Beatles key files can omit changes; no stationary-control inference from a single-key Beatles annotation.

songs.title: Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds

source.license: Not specified by original source; selected factual ranges only are reproduced here, not chord files or audio.
source.annotator: Isophonics curators; secondary musical analysis by Alan W. Pollack

songs.selection_rationale: Independent A verse/Bb bridge/G refrain with explicit transitional ambiguity; first cycle selected before predictions. Held out.
limitations: Pollack places G at the end of the bridge; Isophonics waits until the refrain. Both keys are accepted in 45.282063-50.487 s and this boundary is not used as a hard change-time target.
Later cycles are not scored: the published keylab omits the A return at the second verse, so copying the whole file would create known incorrect expectations.
